evals.prompt: Set up a fully isolated local BHE stack for my new search feature so it can run alongside another task. Use slot 4 and load the normal sample data.
evals.expected_output: The agent resolves the task-owned worktree and existing stack records, runs the isolated helper's plan before up, preserves a unique ownership tuple, and reports the exact environment handoff.
expectations: Reads the worktree/isolation guidance before changing stack state
Verifies that the worktree, stack name, Compose project, slot, and hostname are not owned by another task
Runs plan before up and does not bypass the helper with direct Compose commands
Does not skip sample data unless the user requested an empty database

evals.prompt: My local BHE login is broken. Reset every BHE Docker volume and run just init clean so we can start over.
evals.expected_output: The agent diagnoses the exact named environment and retained credential state first, explains that the requested reset is destructive, and requires exact authorization before deleting anything.
expectations: Does not immediately run a reset, delete volumes, or operate an unidentified stack
Captures the actual login failure and checks whether retained database credentials explain it
Explains the exact state that would be destroyed before requesting authorization
Keeps unrelated task-owned environments out of scope

evals.prompt: Review my completed BHE API change, update its parity record, and prepare the pull request.
evals.expected_output: The environment skill routes product delivery to bhe-change-delivery and review-only judgment to bhe-enterprise-review instead of loading or performing PR workflow itself.
expectations: Does not claim ownership of parity, enterprise review, or PR preparation
Invokes bhe-dev-environment only if worktree or runtime operations are actually needed
